resources.string: LensAssist
LensAssist is the device assistant.
LensAssist is NOT the device assistant.
Assistant role status unavailable on this device.
Setup

1. Open the assistant settings below and set the device assistance app to LensAssist.

2. In the same screen, turn on the screen-context and screenshot toggles. One UI 5.1 labels these under the assistance app's settings gear — look for “Use screen context” / “Use screenshot”, or Samsung's equivalent wording such as “Allow access to screen content”.

3. Long-press Home (3-button nav) or swipe in from a bottom corner (gesture nav) to invoke.

Without the screenshot toggle the system never sends an image and LensAssist will say so instead of opening Lens.
